metadata.description: Vendored Claude Code mods, skills and plugins for trying out UI upgrades.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Mod: tool rows with icons, diff, table and Mermaid cards, a usage band and fifteen themes. /skin swaps them live.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: Mod: an IDE-style file tree pane with git status and a shimmer on files Claude touches. /filetree toggles it.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Mod: step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time. /replay opens it.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod: a progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel for subagents.

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Skill + agents: plan, delegate to tiered worker subagents, review. Drives the savvy-progress bar.

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Mod: checks short prompts for corrections and offers to save them as CLAUDE.md rules from a band above the prompt.
